space.expression: 2^n poly(input size), using the general-norm constant-approximation solver

notes: The Euclidean specialization p=2 of the smoothness-based covering algorithm improves the dependence on approximation accuracy. This is an alternative algorithmic bound rather than a claim to beat the already known 2^{n+o(n)} exact Euclidean CVP bound. No numerical leading coefficient is inferred from the hidden 2^{O(n)} factor.

extra.preprocessing: Included, using a general-norm 2-CVP subroutine; covering generated locally
extra.success: Randomized success at least 1-2^{-n}; deterministic net enumeration is also discussed

evidence.locator: Abstract; §1, item (5); Theorem 4.6, using the ℓ₂ modulus of smoothness with power q=2
